title: Suicidal Thoughts
subtitle: What suicidal thoughts is, causes, risk factors, symptoms, evaluation, management, lifestyle considerations, and safety.
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports the identification, assessment, and treatment of suicidal thoughts as critical components in suicide prevention. Emerging evidence continues to improve understanding of biological and psychosocial mechanisms. Limitations exist in predicting suicide attempts from ideation alone.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
